module_summary: Sequence detector FSM recognizing pattern in serial data stream; outputs pulse when detected.

anchors.name: pos
anchors.why: 3-bit state register tracking position in target sequence; controls all state transitions.

anchors.name: sequence_detected
anchors.why: Output flag asserted when final sequence state (SQD_E) is reached.

anchors.name: on_e
anchors.why: Decoder detecting final state; gates one state transition and drives output.

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: State register implementing 5-state finite state machine for sequence detection.

groups.name: Detection Output
groups.description: Final-state decoder and detection output; asserts when target sequence matched.
